case: Independent native pocket import, save, reopen, export and workspace capture on the combined source build
native_interaction: Started with an empty revision-0 project. File > Import garment OBJ… opened the original two-cutout pocket fixture with physical vertex positions expressed in millimetres.
No unit was selected and Import was disabled. Choosing Millimetres showed 1 OBJ unit = 1 mm, Y up, 1 exterior contour, 2 cutouts and 1 assigned fabric. Import was enabled.
Import committed revision 1 with 1 piece, 0 seams, 0 groups and 47 rest vertices. The Scene showed piece_2 (#3), Hole #12 and Hole #21.
Used Frame all, saved Combined pocket.weftforge, reopened it at revision 1, framed it and exported Combined pocket.obj with its companion MTL.

Selected Hole #21 in the reopened Pattern inspector. Both holes showed four edges. The inspector reported pattern width 0.240 m and height 0.360 m. Saved Combined pocket workspace.png with the smaller aperture selected; the native status reported 1640 × 1000 px.
comparison: The native revision-1 project, native rest OBJ and its MTL matched the earlier independent CLI output byte-for-byte.
historical_run: The earlier two-fabric, draped refusal and editable-corner undo/redo cases ran separately on 087123cfcd0ea48001716006bcb8f32ce8aa2fa8. This receipt records a fresh GUI process from the combined checkout. Both compiled GUI files share the recorded digest.
